messages:
sara: Quick proposal  90m copy huddle Friday to finalize Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing heroes + one launch post angle and webinar CTA.

leo: +1. Can we keep hero length to one line + 2 bullets? helps dev readability.

anya: i'll bring a 1-page benchmark (latency + cost with batching) and two customer blurbs.

matt: i'll draft HubSpot fields: use_case, team_size, compliance, expected_rps. routing: if team_size>50 OR compliance=true -> enterprise-sales; use_case==evaluation -> webinar nurture; else -> demo queue. will add utm_campaign=launch_orbit.

julia: timeboxes: 20m heroes, 30m body/proof, 25m webinar CTAs, 15m routing + next steps.

sara: owners: leo (heroes + 2 launch-post angles), anya (benchmarks + proof bullets), matt (routing + tracking snippet), julia (notes + facilitator). pre-read due Thu 5pm PT.

leo: quick hero drafts:
- Hosted: "Get started in minutes  production-ready inference"
- Dedicated: "Reserved capacity  predictable throughput"
- Private: "Run inference in your VPC  enterprise controls"

anya: small tweak for Hosted: "Start in minutes  enterprise-grade inference". i'll attach charts.

matt: confirmation page snippet: `window.dataLayer.push({event: 'lead_submitted', utm_campaign: 'launch_orbit'})`. will wire the 48h auto-nudge.

sara: perfect. aim to have final copy and the launch post draft by next Monday. thanks! :tada:
